card.title: The Callback Changes Meaning
card.instruction: Treat every returning phrase or action as evidence the relationship has changed. Repeat it with a new emotional meaning each time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Make yourself at home. I've put fresh coffee on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Make yourself at home? I thought you meant a weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just until my flat is repaired.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Make yourself at home. I'll clear the drawer, but we're counting weekends together.
